3. Revenue is 78% US-stock volume [Actual]: an AI/tech correction hits the core directly, and the HK$95.1B margin book is pro-cyclical leverage that impairs in exactly that regime.

**Core risks:** (1) CSRC escalation beyond the booked penalty (forced mainland closure); (2) class action (26-cv-05453) settlement exceeding ~$300M [Assumption]; (3) PCAOB/HFCAA access revocation → HK-only delisting with liquidity discount; (4) commission compression from Tiger/Longbridge; (5) net-cash attribution overstated if the customer-deposit split is worse than assumed.

**5-year failure pre-mortem — "Assume we lost 50% of capital in 5 years (stock ≈ $58): what went wrong?"** We treated the May 2026 penalty as the terminal regulatory event; it was step one.
